images.prompt: Premium editorial illustration, high-end tech magazine style: a long dark corridor lined with identical open lit doorways receding into the distance, and at the far end one single closed door with a small red light beside it. Deep dark navy (#161a45) dominant palette filling most of the frame, soft cream (#F4EFE3) highlights used sparingly, thin red (#eb2027) accent lines only — no green, no purple, no rainbow palettes. Cinematic moody lighting, minimalist composition. Full-bleed edge-to-edge artwork: the scene fills the entire frame corner to corner, no border, no cream margin, no white matting, no picture frame, no empty background field. No text, no numbers, no letters, no labels, no writing, no logos anywhere in the image.
